name: AO SMITH X2 Neo +
summary: The A.O. Smith X2 Neo+ is a sleek and compact UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm) . Its advanced 5-stage UV + Ultra Shield + Silver Activated Post Carbon (SAPC) purification system delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.
intro: The A.O. Smith X2 Neo+is a stylish, compact UV water purifier designed for homes with municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm). It features an advanced 5-stage UV + Ultra Shield + Silver Activated Post Carbon (SAPC)purification system that delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water. Equipped with a digital display, touch dispensing, and flexible wall-mount or tabletop installation, the X2 Neo is ideal for modern kitchens. As a direct-flow purifier, it provides purified water instantly without a storage tank.
